name: Disobedient Children
overview: Scripture sternly addresses the seriousness of disobedience in children, emphasizing the gravity of actions such as striking or cursing one's parents, which were met with the ultimate penalty in the Old Testament (Exodus 21:15,17; Leviticus 20:9). The rebellious nature of a stubborn son who refuses to obey and heed parental discipline is explicitly condemned (Deuteronomy 21:18), underscoring the importance of honoring and submitting to parental authority. Furthermore, Proverbs highlights that loving discipline, including timely correction, is an expression of true parental care (Proverbs 13:24), while Leviticus warns of consequences for failing to obey God's commandments (Leviticus 26:14), linking disobedience to broader covenantal unfaithfulness.
